narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona from mid morning through early evening. A couple of storms downed trees and produced flash flooding in the Tucson Metro area.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5 in 2-3 hours caused Old Ajo Hwy. and West Snyder Hill Rd. north of Ryan Field to be closed due to flash flooding.
Heavy rain of 1-2' in less than 1 hour caused the flooding of Magee Rd. east of La Canada Dr. at Pegler Wash and the closure of Ina Rd. at Pima Wash east of Oracle Rd.

Heavy rain of 1-2 in less than 1 hour caused urban washes to flow over roadways from midtown to southeast Tucson. One person was washed downstream in the Columbus Wash near Blacklidge Dr. but was able to get themselves to safety. A young woman was rescued from her car which was stuck in Arcadia Wash near Pima and Rosemont. Kolb Rd. was closed between Irvington and Valencia while Irvington Rd. was closed due to flooding at the Atterbury Wash.
